subject: SIG preflight: compiling documents & answers for Nimbus Health security review
messages:
From: Emma Jenkins <emma.jenkins@nimbushealth.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, procurement@nimbushealth.com
Date: 2026-11-12T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: SIG: Request for evidence ahead of Nimbus Health security review

Hi Priya —

We’re kicking off our vendor security review for Q4 and would like to complete the SIG (Standardized Information Gathering) questionnaire for Redwood before our governance meeting on Dec 3. Our procurement deadline to accept the package is Nov 30, so ideally we’d have the completed questionnaire and supporting artifacts by end-of-day Nov 30.

Can you confirm what you can provide by that date and whether you need any clarification on the SIG questions? Key asks for us: SOC 2 scope confirmation, encryption-at-rest artifacts, and the data retention policy mapping (questions 22–45).

Attachments: initial_request.docx (procurement template)

Thanks,
Emma Jenkins
Sr. Vendor Risk Analyst
Nimbus Health

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Emma Jenkins <emma.jenkins@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, dylan_brooks@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-12T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SIG: Request for evidence ahead of Nimbus Health security review

Hi Emma —

Thanks for the heads up and the timeline. We can meet the Nov 30 procurement cutoff with a conditioned delivery: a completed SIG spreadsheet plus supporting artifacts and an evidence index. There are a few questions that typically need engineering verification (encryption key rotation windows, KMS provider exportability) so we’ll mark those as "verifying" in the tracker.

Plan: I’m looping in Marissa (controls evidence) and Dylan (infra artifacts). We’ll: 
- Populate the SIG answers and mark items as "attached", "in progress", or "verifying"
- Drop a consolidated evidence zip and a one-page evidence index
- Note any open items with expected dates

I’ve started a preflight checklist and the evidence tracker (attached). We’ll aim to send the partial package by Nov 25 and final package Nov 30 EOD. If you have a hard dependency on any single artifact earlier, flag it and we’ll prioritize.

Attachments: SIG_preflight_checklist.pdf

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

- SOC 2 Type II report (redacted) — controls/attest/soc2_2026_redacted.pdf

Subject: SIG package: partial delivery + clarification request (question Q42)

Hi Emma —

We dropped a partial package into the shared Drive for your review. Package contents: completed SIG answers where we could attach artifacts, SOC 2 redacted report, access policy, encryption statements, and the evidence tracker that ties file names to question IDs. A zip of the partial bundle is attached.

One clarification request before we finalize the last items: Question Q42 in your SIG asks for the data retention mapping by customer class. Our standard policy is retained in the Data Retention Policy (controls/policies/data_retention_v2.pdf), but we’d like to confirm the granularity Nimbus needs for the mapping (per-customer table vs. per-product category). Can you confirm what procurement expects? If you need per-customer mappings we’ll add a short supplemental CSV (estimated by Nov 30 EOD).

Attachments: sig_partial_package.zip
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cSIGTracker

Regards,
Priya Natarajan
Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
